info.title: EL English Mentor API
info.description: Canonical cross-client contract for authentication, profile, shared settings, the learning catalog, immutable learning events, and server-derived progress.

servers.description: Production placeholder; deployment configuration supplies the actual hostname.

tags.name: Flashcards
tags.description: Flashcard decks, cards and server-scheduled spaced repetition.

post.summary: Register a user and create a session
Rotate a refresh session and return a new access token
post.description: For `web`, the request body MUST be omitted and the refresh token is supplied only by a Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite cookie. For `android`, the request body is required and contains the refresh token obtained from secure device storage. A successful Web response never includes a refresh token in JSON; the rotated token is set only in Set-Cookie. A successful Android response includes the rotated refresh token in its JSON body for storage in a Keystore-backed encrypted store.

204.description: Current session revoked. Web clients also receive a clearing Set-Cookie header.

post.summary: Revoke all active refresh-token families for the authenticated user

get.summary: Get the authenticated user identity
Get the authenticated user's profile

patch.description: The caller must send the profile revision returned by GET as If-Match. A 409 response means the profile changed on another client and must be re-read before retrying.

get.summary: Get minimal synchronized learning settings
get.description: Theme, sound, reduced-motion, local push permission, and other device presentation state are intentionally not part of this initial synchronized contract.

get.summary: Get the minimal server-authoritative progress read model
Get backend-derived XP, level, streak, private achievements, and missions
get.description: Read-only projection. Clients must not calculate, persist, or submit engagement state.

get.summary: Get the private backend-derived learning campaign map
get.description: Read-only deterministic map over active catalog records and accepted lesson completions. The catalog remains fully open; recommendedNodeId is guidance only and is not a lock, reward, or mastery claim.

get.summary: Get private server-derived streak recovery eligibility
get.description: Read-only private eligibility. The response never exposes source events, recovery history, or client-calculated streak state.

post.summary: Claim one eligible private streak recovery
post.description: Learner-triggered, server-authoritative mutation. It accepts no request body and no client-provided date, streak, timezone, evidence, XP, or reward. An Idempotency-Key retry returns the original accepted result.

get.summary: List the authenticated user's completed lessons
get.description: Derived exclusively from accepted immutable learning events; there is no separate completion authority. completedAt is the occurredAt of the earliest accepted lesson.completed event for that lesson. Completing the same lesson again does not change completedAt and does not add a second entry.

get.summary: List active subjects in display order
Get one active subject
List active topics for a subject in display order
Get one active topic
List active lessons for a topic in display order
Get one active lesson

post.summary: Append one immutable completed-learning event and receive canonical progress
post.description: User ownership comes exclusively from the bearer token. This is an immutable learning event. Clients submit only completion intent and allowed event facts; XP is derived from the authoritative lesson by the server and clients must not calculate or claim it. lesson.completed is the only currently accepted event type. The Idempotency-Key header is a client-generated UUIDv7 and can be retried safely. The server accepts an event at most once; the same key and equivalent normalized client payload returns the original canonical result with 200, while reuse with a different payload returns 409.

get.summary: List active quizzes for one active lesson
get.description: The lessonId query parameter is required. Only active quizzes reachable through the active learning catalog are returned.

get.summary: Get active quiz detail without answer keys
get.description: Question and answer-option ordering is server-defined. Correct answers are never exposed in quiz-detail responses.

post.summary: Submit one immutable quiz attempt and receive the server-scored result
post.description: User ownership comes exclusively from the bearer token. Clients submit only quizId and selected answer-option IDs. Score, correctness, XP, completion, achievements, and timestamps are server-owned and forbidden in the request. All questions are required. The Idempotency-Key header is user-scoped; an equivalent retry returns the original result with 200 and never creates a duplicate attempt.

post.summary: Generate an AI tutor response for a lesson
post.description: Submits a student message for a specific lesson and receives an AI-generated tutor response. Idempotent via Idempotency-Key header. Replay returns the original stored response. Unknown lesson, invalid payload, rate limit, and provider failures use standard error codes. Refused responses (safety filter) return a successful response with status=refused.

get.summary: List active flashcard decks for one active lesson
get.description: The lessonId query parameter is required. Only active decks reachable through the active learning catalog are returned.

get.summary: Get one active deck with its cards
Get the authenticated learner's review queue for one deck
get.description: Returns each card with its server-derived review state, ordered by dueAt then displayOrder. Cards never reviewed are due immediately at box 1.

post.summary: Submit one immutable review outcome and receive the recalculated schedule
post.description: User ownership comes exclusively from the bearer token. Clients submit only the card, the outcome and when the review happened; box, due date and mastery are derived by the server and must not be calculated or claimed by a client. Flashcard reviews earn no XP. The Idempotency-Key header is a client-generated UUIDv7 and can be retried safely: the same key with an equivalent payload returns the original result with 200, while reuse with a different payload returns 409.

post.summary: Reset the authenticated learner's review state for one deck
post.description: Returns every card in the deck to box 1, due immediately. Idempotent via the Idempotency-Key header.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access JWT supplied in the Authorization header.

ClientPlatform.name: X-Client-Platform
ClientPlatform.description: Determines refresh-token transport only: web uses a Secure HttpOnly cookie; android uses the documented JSON field and secure device storage.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Opaque entity revision returned in the prior response ETag header.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated UUIDv7 identifying one immutable mutation submission.

DueOnlyQuery.name: dueOnly
DueOnlyQuery.description: When true (the default) only cards whose dueAt has passed are returned.

RequestId.description: Server-generated request correlation ID. It is also present in the response meta or error body.

ETag.description: Opaque revision token for conditional profile and settings updates.

RefreshCookie.description: Web only: Set-Cookie refresh token with Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/api/v1/auth, and an appropriate expiry. Never expose its value to JavaScript or logs.

IdempotentReplay.description: Present and true when an idempotent attempt submission replays a prior accepted result.

RefreshedSession.description: Refresh token rotated and a new access token issued.

Engagement.description: Server-derived engagement projection; no client-supplied awards or progress.

Campaign.description: Private server-derived campaign projection over the active catalog.

StreakRecoveryClaimCreated.description: A private streak recovery was accepted without XP, mission, currency, item, ranking, or unlock reward.

StreakRecoveryClaimReplay.description: Idempotent replay of the original accepted private recovery claim.

StreakRecoveryUnavailable.description: Streak recovery is not currently eligible. The error contains only a safe reason code.

LessonCompletions.description: The authenticated user's completed lessons, derived from accepted immutable learning events.

LearningEventAccepted.description: A new immutable learning event was accepted and progress was projected.

LearningEventReplay.description: A retry of an equivalent accepted learning event. No duplicate progress was awarded.

Quizzes.description: Active quizzes in display order for one active lesson.

Quiz.description: Active quiz detail without correct answer keys.

QuizAttemptAccepted.description: A new immutable quiz attempt was scored and accepted.

QuizAttemptReplay.description: A retry of an equivalent accepted quiz attempt. No duplicate attempt or award was created.

QuizIdempotencyConflict.description: A quiz-attempt idempotency key was reused with a different payload.

InvalidQuizAttempt.description: The submitted quiz attempt is semantically invalid.

QuizNotFound.description: The requested active quiz or quiz lesson was not found.

RevisionConflict.description: The resource changed after the caller read it.

IdempotencyConflict.description: An idempotency key was reused with a different payload.

InvalidLearningEvent.description: The submitted learning event is semantically invalid.

LearningNotFound.description: The requested active learning resource was not found.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server failure without sensitive diagnostics.

TutorResponseCreated.description: A new AI tutor response was generated and stored.

TutorResponseReplay.description: A retry returned the previously stored tutor response.

TutorLessonNotFound.description: The lesson does not exist or is inactive.

TutorIdempotencyConflict.description: The idempotency key was reused with a different payload.

TutorProviderError.description: The AI provider returned an error.

TutorTimeout.description: The AI provider did not respond in time.

FlashcardDecks.description: Active flashcard decks in display order for one active lesson.

FlashcardDeck.description: One active deck with its active cards in display order.

FlashcardQueue.description: The authenticated learner's review queue, ordered by dueAt then displayOrder.

FlashcardReviewAccepted.description: A new review was accepted and the schedule was recalculated.

FlashcardReviewReplay.description: An equivalent review was already accepted for this idempotency key; the original result is replayed.

FlashcardDeckReset.description: The learner's review state for this deck was reset.

FlashcardNotFound.description: The deck or card does not exist or is inactive.

InvalidFlashcardReview.description: The review payload is invalid, future-dated, or references a card outside the active catalog.

FlashcardIdempotencyConflict.description: The idempotency key was reused with a different payload.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC, for example 2026-07-20T08:00:00Z.

timezone.description: Validated IANA timezone selected by the learner; defaults to Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.

completed.description: True when any daily learning path is complete.

EngagementProjection.description: Backend-authoritative read model. XP is copied only from existing accepted first-time lesson awards.

StreakRecoveryEligibilityProjection.description: Private, server-derived recovery eligibility. No qualifying action, source record, timezone history, XP, reward, or mission data is exposed.

timezone.description: Optional additive field. If omitted, the existing server-owned timezone is retained.

xpEarned.description: Server-derived XP award for the authoritative lesson. Clients must not calculate or claim this value.

scorePercentage.description: Server-computed percentage rounded to two decimal places.

completedAt.description: The occurredAt of the earliest accepted lesson.completed event for this lesson.

accessToken.description: Bearer access token. Do not log or persist it in browser storage.

refreshToken.description: Android responses only. Store only in Keystore-backed encrypted device storage; never log. Web uses Set-Cookie instead.
Android responses only; absent for web.

FlashcardReviewState.description: Server-derived review state. Clients must not calculate or claim these values.

box.description: Leitner box. 1 is new, 5 is fully learned.

algorithmVersion.description: Scheduling algorithm that produced this state, e.g. leitner-5box-v1. Backend-owned; clients display it only for diagnostics.

FlashcardReviewRequest.description: Clients submit only what happened. Box, due date and mastery are server-derived and forbidden here.

outcome.description: Extensible: additional grades may be added without a breaking change.
